Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 26 now!
Synopsis :
Dhananand declares to punish the innocent farmer in front of his subjects. Chandragupta fails to alter Dhananand's decision. Dhananand orders Chandragupta to be present when the farmer receives his punishment for offending Durdhara publicly. He becomes ruthless as he orders his men to bury the farmer alive. Dhananand ignores the farmer's family plead in order to set fear among his subject if they try to go against him. Later, Chandragupta confronts Chanakya as he does not like Dhananand's decision about the farmer.
